digest.component_or_area: close transition path, acceptance criteria validation
propositions: Close transition fails deterministically before LLM dispatch if ticket description contains any unchecked '- [ ]' checkbox items in the Acceptance Criteria block that lack the [operator-attested] tag.
Unchecked checkbox items prefixed with [operator-attested] tag (case-insensitive) are exempt from the precheck and do not block close.
The precheck reuses the existing det_operator_attested._OPERATOR_ATTESTED_TAG_RE regex to ensure consistent tag matching across both surfaces.
Close classes that bypass the verifier today (duplicate, not_a_bug, escalated) remain unaffected by the new precheck.
Tickets with prose-only Acceptance Criteria (no checkbox syntax) pass the precheck unchanged.
